artworks.label: Harvest Basket
artworks.subject: one deep curved woven harvest basket with a graceful loop handle, holding three persimmons and a sprig of muted teal leaves. Tactile hand-carved WOODBLOCK PRINT on warm ivory fibrous paper, flat restrained rust-orange, persimmon-orange and muted teal inks, irregular carved hatch marks, block-printed edges. Basket is the unmistakable main subject with generous negative space
